totp.qrLabel: QR code for setting up the authenticator app
totp.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, for example on your phone.
totp.manual: Can’t scan it? Enter this key in the app instead:
totp.codeHint: Enter the {length}-digit code the app now shows.

key.nameHint: Helps you tell your keys apart, e.g. “YubiKey on my keyring”. Up to {max} characters.
key.nameMissing: Enter a name for the security key first.

unavailable.server: Security keys are not enabled on this Hexmark installation. The authenticator app works regardless.
unavailable.browser: This browser cannot use security keys on this page: they need a secure connection (https://) and a browser that supports them.

recovery.onceDetail: Each one signs you in once if you cannot use your second factor. They are shown only this time.
recovery.savedConfirm: I have saved my recovery codes
recovery.savedFirst: Confirm first that you have saved the recovery codes.

file.title: Hexmark recovery codes
file.singleUse: Each code works once, in place of your second factor.
file.keepSafe: Keep them somewhere safe, apart from your password.

copy.failedDetail: The browser did not allow it here. Select the text and copy it by hand.

errors.attemptsLeft: {count, plural, one {# more attempt} other {# more attempts}} before you have to sign in again.

attempts_exhausted.title: Too many wrong answers
attempts_exhausted.detail: For your security this sign-in was ended. Sign in again.

challenge_invalid.title: Time is up
challenge_invalid.detail: This step is no longer valid. Start again.

invalid_code.title: Code not correct
invalid_code.detail: Check the code and try again.

webauthn_failed.title: Security key not accepted
webauthn_failed.detail: The key’s answer could not be verified. Try again, or use another key.

webauthn_registration_failed.title: Security key not registered
webauthn_registration_failed.detail: The key’s answer could not be verified, or took too long. Try again.

webauthn_unavailable.title: Security keys not available
webauthn_unavailable.detail: This Hexmark installation does not offer security keys.

webauthn_cancelled.title: Cancelled
webauthn_cancelled.detail: The security key did not answer: it was cancelled, timed out, or no matching key was used.

webauthn_browser_failed.title: Security key did not work
webauthn_browser_failed.detail: The browser reported a problem with the key. Try again, or use another way.

method_unavailable.title: Not set up for this account
method_unavailable.detail: This way of confirming is not set up for your account. Choose another one.

unauthenticated.title: Signed out
unauthenticated.detail: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

invalid_password.title: Password not correct
invalid_password.detail: Check your password and try again.

totp_already_enabled.title: Already set up
totp_already_enabled.detail: An authenticator app is already set up for this account.

totp_not_pending.title: Set-up expired
totp_not_pending.detail: Start setting up the authenticator app again.

totp_not_enabled.title: No authenticator app
totp_not_enabled.detail: No authenticator app is set up for this account.

credential_not_found.title: Security key not found
credential_not_found.detail: It may have been removed already. The list has been updated.

credential_exists.title: Already registered
credential_exists.detail: This security key is already registered for your account.

last_factor_required.title: Last second factor
last_factor_required.detail: Two-factor authentication is required on this installation. Add another factor before removing this one.

second_factor_missing.title: No second factor yet
second_factor_missing.detail: Set up an authenticator app or a security key first.

rate_limited.title: Too many attempts
rate_limited.detail: Wait a few minutes, then try again.

validation.title: Input not accepted
validation.detail: Check what you entered and try again.

setup_token_present.title: Sign-in blocked
setup_token_present.detail: The setup token is still set on the server. Reload the page.

server_not_configured.title: Server configuration incomplete
server_not_configured.detail: A required key is missing or invalid on the server. Check the server log.

database_unavailable.title: Database not available
database_unavailable.detail: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, check the server log.

server_unreachable.title: Server not reachable
server_unreachable.detail: Make sure the Hexmark server is running, then try again.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong on the server
unexpected.detail: Try again. If it keeps happening, check the server log.
